style_authority: Each batch must pin the confirmed reference files and hashes; do not replace the approved direction from old prose.

paid_budget.remaining_budget_source: Current private Tripo ledger, including actual, reserved and unknown submissions
paid_budget.shared_asset_policy: Reuse accepted versioned props and materials without regenerating or charging again

dispatch_rule: Re-read the current accepted game definitions and freeze their SHA before creating each batch; this plan cannot dispatch paid API calls.

batches.shared_props: Reuse the six life-prop families already present in the approved production manifest
batches.cost_policy: Existing 3000-credit batch cap; reuse completed candidates, increment only a reworked asset revision
batches.acceptance: Batch visual decision bound to the exact package; approval automatically enqueues asset-library integration

batches.scope: Complete the ordinary eight-level visual progression
batches.dependency: Current sample accepted and remaining-level scope explicitly released; costs remain within HOUSE-COMMON-001 cap unless later separately authorized
batches.reuse: Approved human scale, 16m courtyard conventions, material standards and shared life props
batches.quality_focus: Distinct massing, courtyard organization, materials and workmanship at every level

batches.scope: High-frequency city logistics and commerce silhouettes
batches.dependency: Separate scope and funding; reusable stall, basket, jar and storage modules should precede paid full-building variants
batches.quality_focus: Visible entrances, loading space and storage contents; preserve current simulation dimensions

batches.scope: M3 public and cultural service landmarks
batches.dependency: Separate scope and funding; use current service definitions without inventing additional gameplay
batches.quality_focus: Readable service identity at normal game distance; believable activity and shared scale

batches.scope: Existing production chains and agricultural modules
batches.dependency: Separate scope and funding; procedural crop, tool, material-pile and modular building assets first
batches.quality_focus: Human, animal and water-powered production; visible materials and work without changing simulation rules

batches.dependency: Elite definitions and scope frozen, separate funding authorized, ordinary housing visual grammar accepted

integration_constraints.approved_asset_library: Only current accepted versioned UE packages and an approved catalog; no preview map or prior unapproved versions
integration_constraints.gameplay_adapter: Separate bounded engineering task; asset-library inclusion alone does not change game rendering
integration_constraints.current_ordinary_footprint: building.debug.hut is 1x1 at 4m/cell; the 16m art courtyard is not yet the gameplay footprint
integration_constraints.save_compatibility: Never silently enlarge occupied legacy plots or shrink the approved courtyard to fit them
integration_constraints.functional_worker: Never copy into or modify the active unattended game workspace
